cues.label: the film starts
cues.note: Not a musical moment: the timeline has to begin somewhere, and beginning at 0 is honest about that.

cues.label: the grid arrives
cues.note: Placeholder. Once `cvpw analyze` has run against real audio, run `cvpw cues` to settle this onto a measured onset and its source becomes `measured`.

cues.label: the chorus lands
cues.note: The one moment the film is built around. If this is wrong, every shot after it is wrong too.

cues.label: the burst has settled
cues.note: The end of the loudest shot. Equal to `settle` today, and named separately because they are two different decisions: one ends a shot, the other begins the last one.
